hints.title: Double Breadth-First Search
hints.text: Run a first breadth-first search from node 0 to find the farthest node u, then run a second search from u to find the farthest node v.

hints.title: Find All Diameter Pairs
hints.text: To handle ties for diameter endpoints and ensure lexicographical minimality, record distances from all diameter candidates.

hints.title: Sort Endpoints
hints.text: For the identified pair (u, v), ensure u <= v before returning [u, v].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two BFS traversals visit every node and edge twice.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running all-pairs shortest paths takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance array and queue take O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects classic double-BFS tree diameter algorithm with linear time complexity.
